|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Shadows Of The Empire (Virtual Block 7)]] (version 2 of 4). This version has no document image of its own, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of this text ([[:File:VB7-05-Shadows_Of_The_Empire-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). Versions in date order: [[Shadows Of The Empire (Virtual Block 7)]] (original, release sheet of 16 December 2011); '''this page''' (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Shadows Of The Empire (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Shadows Of The Empire (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Shadows Of The Empire (Virtual Block 7)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet (official text as of 16 December 2011): “Deploy on Agents Of Black Sun. Mistryl are lost. Once per game, may ▲ Secret Plans. May use 3 Force to ▼ Imperial Square, and once per turn, if Emperor Palpatine there, may draw a card from Force Pile (and if you occupy three battlegrounds, opponent loses 1 Force). [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 16 December 2011"), page 2, slip 8 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223114/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 30) prints this text again. Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Shadows Of The Empire (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=30, page 30. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=30 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 December 2012) changed “Once per game, may” to “Once per game may” and “and once per turn, if Emperor Palpatine there,” to “and while Emperor Palpatine there, once per turn,” (the card list writes the ▲ and ▼ icons out in words): “Deploy on Agents Of Black Sun. Mistryl are lost. Once per game may ▲ Secret Plans. May use 3 Force to ▼ Imperial Square, and while Emperor Palpatine there, once per turn, may draw a card from Force Pile (and if you occupy three battlegrounds, opponent loses 1 Force). [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="cl-1274_8-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Shadows Of The Empire (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-shadowsoftheempire-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Shadows Of The Empire (Virtual Block 7)]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on Agents Of Black Sun. Mistryl are lost. Once per game, may ▲ Secret Plans. May use 3 Force to ▼ Imperial Square, and once per turn, if Emperor Palpatine there, may draw a card from Force Pile (and if you occupy three battlegrounds, opponent loses 1 Force). [Immune to Alter]” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual7-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual7-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034727/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Shadows Of The Empire (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 30)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Shadows Of The Empire (Virtual Block 7)]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on Agents Of Black Sun. Mistryl are lost. Once per game, may ▲ Secret Plans. May use 3 Force to ▼ Imperial Square, and once per turn, if Emperor Palpatine there, may draw a card from Force Pile (and if you occupy three battlegrounds, opponent loses 1 Force). [Immune to Alter]” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1274-8-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
